registerRows: SELECT i.*,t.data FROM legal_items i JOIN {table} t ON t.item_id=i.id WHERE {visibility} AND {purchase} AND i.kind=? ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 10001
holdPreview: WITH RECURSIVE linked(id) AS (SELECT ?::text UNION SELECT l.target_id FROM linked t JOIN legal_links l ON l.source_id=t.id WHERE l.relation IN ('evidence','derived','amends','obligation')) SELECT i.id,i.title FROM linked t JOIN legal_items i ON i.id=t.id WHERE {visibility} AND {purchase}
